# Security Policy

The KubeEdge community takes the security of our software seriously. If you believe you have found a security vulnerability in KubeEdge, please report it responsibly using one of the private channels below.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

**Please DO NOT report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues, discussions, or pull requests.**

### 1. Private Vulnerability Reporting (Preferred)
You can report vulnerabilities privately via GitHub Security Advisories:
* Go to the [Security Advisories](https://github.com/kubeedge/kubeedge/security/advisories) tab of this repository.
* Click on **"Report a vulnerability"** to open a private advisory draft directly with the maintainers.

### 2. Security Team Email (Alternative)
If you prefer email or cannot access the GitHub advisory interface, please email the KubeEdge Security Team directly:
* **Email:** [cncf-kubeedge-security@lists.cncf.io](mailto:cncf-kubeedge-security@lists.cncf.io)

### Response Timeline
* **Initial Acknowledgment:** Within 48 hours.
* **Triage & Assessment:** Within 7 business days.
* **Coordinated Disclosure:** Once a fix is verified, a patch release and public security advisory will be coordinated.

## Scope & Supported Versions
For the list of actively supported releases, vulnerability disclosure procedures, and PGP keys, please refer to the official [KubeEdge Community Security Policy](https://github.com/kubeedge/community/blob/master/team-security/SECURITY.md).
